crossRefs.note: He looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the land of the plain, and saw that the smoke of the land went up…
that all of its land is sulfur, salt, and burning, that it is not sown, doesn’t produce, nor does any grass grow in it…
There will dwell in his tent that which is none of his. Sulfur will be scattered on his habitation.
On the wicked he will rain blazing coals; fire, sulfur, and scorching wind shall be the portion of their cup.
but in the day that Lot went out from Sodom, it rained fire and sulfur from the sky and destroyed them all.
Even as Sodom and Gomorrah and the cities around them, having in the same way as these given themselves over to sexual…
The beast was taken, and with him the false prophet who worked the signs in his sight, with which he deceived those who…
But for the cowardly, unbelieving, sinners, abominable, murderers, sexually immoral, sorcerers, idolaters, and all…

translations.web: Its streams will be turned into pitch, its dust into sulfur, And its land will become burning pitch.
translations.bsb: Edom’s streams will be turned to tar, and her soil to sulfur; her land will become a blazing pitch.
translations.kjv: And the streams thereof shall be turned into pitch, and the dust thereof into brimstone, and the land thereof shall become burning pitch.
translations.asv: And the streams of Edom shall be turned into pitch, and the dust thereof into brimstone, and the land thereof shall become burning pitch.
